metadata.description: Claude Code mods and plugins hosted at github.com/isabel-nh.

plugins.name: sentinel
plugins.description: Marks every file Claude writes with a manual-review sentinel line, guards it from removal, and blocks commits until a person deletes it.

plugins.name: env-rejector
plugins.description: Denies Read, Bash and Grep access to .env files and strips .env hits from Grep results, so secrets stay out of the model's context.

plugins.name: git-aware-fs
plugins.description: Routes rm and mv of git-tracked paths through git rm and git mv so the index stays in sync.

plugins.name: commitmsg-formatter
plugins.description: Validates git commit messages: one leading gitmoji, 50-character subject, 72-column body, no colon prefix, no editor-opening commits.
